title: TRICARE Select Tier Placement from the DEERS Record
content:
**Enrollment rule.** The **TRICARE Select** tier is fixed by the DEERS record, never by the caller's description. The DEERS beneficiary category must be one of the tier's eligible beneficiary categories; the sponsor's initial entry date places the family in Group A when it is before 2018-01-01 and in Group B when it is on or after 2018-01-01; and for active duty family members the sponsor's DEERS pay grade places the family in the E-1 to E-4 tier (E-1, E-2, E-3 and E-4) or the E-5 and above tier (every other grade, warrant officers and commissioned officers included). Transitional survivors take the active duty family tier of their group and the sponsor's pay grade at death. The beneficiary's DEERS beneficiary category, sponsor entry date and sponsor pay grade match the requested Select tier.

A promotion or reduction that moves the sponsor across the E-4/E-5 line moves the family's enrollments to the matching tier from January 1 of the next plan year, and deductibles already met that year stand. When DEERS stops showing the beneficiary in any Select category (sponsor retirement, separation, divorce, aging out) the enrollment is terminated as ineligible on the last day of eligibility; a retiring sponsor's family re-enrolls in a retiree tier within the qualifying-life-event window, effective on the retirement date.

## The match that must hold

The match is read from the system record for the beneficiary concerned (DEERS beneficiary category, sponsor initial entry date, sponsor pay grade and sponsor), before an enrollment is registered, activated or moved to another tier.

| DEERS shows | Group | Pay-grade band |
|---|---|---|
| sponsor first entered 2017-12-31 | Group A | - |
| sponsor first entered 2018-01-01 | Group B | - |
| active duty sponsor at E-4 | - | E-1 to E-4 |
| active duty sponsor at E-5, W-2 or O-3 | - | E-5 and above |

## Worked placements (hypothetical DEERS records)

- Active duty family member, sponsor entered 2015-06-01 at E-3: TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4).
- Transitional survivor, sponsor entered 2019-03-01, pay grade at death E-6: TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above).
- Sponsor promoted from E-4 to E-5 in a hypothetical June: the family's enrollments move to the E-5 and above tier of their group from January 1 of the next plan year; deductibles met in the year of the promotion stand.
